column2: Command has recognised the forward supply depots are too vulnerable.
Fleet will begin transferring these supplies to the checkpoint base just in front of Fort Meru.
Here comes the first wave!
First wave? How many more bugs can we look forward to?
Do you really want an estimate?
No, not really.
Fleet has dropped extra supplies near the checkpoint base.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/DEFEND SECOND LINE/TRIGGERS/EVENTS/EVENT: START TIMER/DIALOGUE: UNDERESTIMATED BUGS ==============

column2: Command admits they may have underestimated the strength of the bug surge. All supplies will be transferred into Fort Meru's depot just in case the outer defenses cannot hold.
Scorpions! Those are gonna be trouble...
Deploy rocket launcher turrets, that's the best weapon we have against Scorps!
Another bug hive has been detected on west our flank. We’ve gotta collapse some of those caves and cut down their numbers.
Fleet has established a new supply depot in the second line. This position should suffice to hold any further Arachnid attacks.

As the most senior officer still on the ground, you've been put in charge of Fort Meru's communication stations and defenses. The Wavebreaker gun batteries should have no trouble obliterating the remaining bug hordes.

Wavebreaker crews, focus your fire on Scorpions! They’ve burnt enough holes in our 
defenses already…
Bugs have tunneled right up to the front walls!  They're right on us!
We've got to hold the line here.

column2: Dropships have arrived with extra supplies and munitions. They will remain on standby to deliver reinforcements.
Alright, let's get some more boots on these walls!
We need more guns and troopers to carry them if we are to hold this fort!
Hang in there. Dropships are already on route to bring more supplies and munitions.
They better get here fast. In the meantime we'll make do with what we have!
All supplies have been extracted from the outer bases and shifted to Fort Meru.
Evacuation is about 50% completed. Hang in there!
All non-combat personel has been evacuated. Get out of there Sam.
Everyone who is still fighting, fall back to the dropships! Get out of here while you're still in one piece!
No more Bugs in sight. Is it over?
Unfortunately, no. Bugs have broken through at multiple points and are now concentrating all their strength on Fort Meru.  It seems inevitable the base is going to fall.
Then we have to evacuate all remaining personnel... Get as many people out as you can.
Everything is falling apart, we're getting slaughtered out here!
